shimla.name: Shimla
shimla.title: Queen of the Hills, Shimla
shimla.description: Breathtaking Himalayan hill station renowned for British colonial architecture, pine-covered ridges, and mountain vistas.

jaipur.name: Jaipur
jaipur.title: The Pink City, Jaipur
jaipur.description: Capital of Rajasthan, famous for opulent royal palaces, fortified hilltop citadels, and vibrant pink sandstone architecture.

japan.name: Japan
japan.title: Japan (Tokyo & Kyoto)
japan.description: A harmonious blend of ultra-modern neon-lit skyscrapers, ancient Shinto shrines, Zen gardens, and world-class culinary traditions.

dubai.name: Dubai
dubai.title: Dubai & Beyond
dubai.description: Futuristic desert metropolis celebrated for soaring skyscrapers, luxury shopping, artificial archipelagos, and vibrant marina lifestyle.

chandigarh.name: Chandigarh
chandigarh.title: The City Beautiful, Chandigarh
chandigarh.description: India’s first planned city masterminded by Le Corbusier, distinguished by extensive green parks, modernist concrete architecture, and Nek Chand’s Rock Garden.
